raw_segments.text: I never met your likeness. Jane, you please me, and you master me, you seem to submit,
and I like the sense of pliancy you impart. And while I am twining the soft, silken skein
round my finger, it sends a thrill up my arm to my heart. I am influenced, conquered,
and the influence is sweeter than I can express, and the conquest I undergo has a witchery
beyond any triumph I can win. Why do you smile, Jane? What is that inexplicable, that uncanny
